sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The sidebar opens channels, profiles, playlists, scenes, live control, history, recovery and activity. Search filters the current section.

sections.title: Start a broadcast
sections.body: Configure a channel and its key in Keychain. Start the wizard from the toolbar, then choose a profile, channel and scene or playlist. TikTok asks for a key on every start.

sections.title: Compose before starting
sections.body: Open the scene composer from the wizard. Check resolution, sources and audio, save the scene and confirm the countdown.

sections.title: Playlists
sections.body: Import videos from a file panel or folder. Reorder and enable items, choose a profile for each video and set resume positions. Live control supports skipping and looping.

sections.title: Scenes
sections.body: Add files, cameras, screens, microphones and overlays. Drag and resize on the canvas, use arrow keys or numeric fields, and enable alignment guides. Grant capture permissions on the Mac. System audio requires a virtual audio device.

sections.title: Buttons and spots
sections.body: Create buttons with a label, source, duration, position, display mode and shortcut. Queue spots, toggle overlays or interrupt the program fullscreen. The program resumes from the position actually sent.

sections.title: Live control
sections.body: Select a broadcast to observe. Preview, mixer, scene, playlist, spot queue, profile and log share one panel. Platform pages use WebKit; YouTube status may remain unverified.

sections.title: Layouts
sections.body: Save a scene as a reusable layout and apply it in the composer. Existing sources fill the layout slots. Canvas dimensions and orientation can be changed.

sections.title: History and recovery
sections.body: Filter broadcasts, view snapshots, restart from the beginning or saved position and delete historical videos. Cleanup reports progress and protects active broadcasts. Recovery unlocks or resumes interrupted sessions.

sections.title: Apple activity
sections.body: CPU, memory, compression, swap, network and disk use macOS counters. FFmpeg processes show PID, CPU, memory and threads. Thermal state and Low Power Mode replace unavailable numerical temperatures.

sections.title: Settings
sections.body: Choose arm64 FFmpeg and FFprobe, refresh codecs, export or import data, change language, appearance and background, and open the log folder. Keychain secrets are excluded from exports.
